rules.title: Protected-resource use detected without a usage description
rules.fix: Apple's App Review guideline 5.1.1(ii) says to make purpose strings clearly and completely describe your use of the data, and Apple's protected-resources page lists these keys. Add the key to Info.plist (or the generated build settings, or localized InfoPlist.strings) with a specific purpose. Detection is a text heuristic: confirm the feature is really used. Photo use that only saves images needs NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription. Test files, docs and lockfiles are ignored.

rules.title: No privacy manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy)
rules.fix: Since May 1, 2024, uploads using required-reason APIs (including via third-party SDKs) need approved reasons declared. Add PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and make sure bundled SDKs ship theirs.

rules.title: App Transport Security disabled globally
rules.fix: Apple's docs: you must supply a justification during App Store review if NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is true. Prefer upgrading servers to HTTPS or using narrower per-domain exceptions.

rules.title: Missing version keys
rules.fix: CFBundleVersion is required by the App Store. CFBundleShortVersionString must be three period-separated integers (for example 1.2.3).

rules.title: Export compliance key not set
rules.fix: If ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is missing, App Store Connect walks you through the export compliance questionnaire on every upload. Set it to false if the app and its libraries use no encryption or only exempt encryption.

rules.title: Third-party login without Sign in with Apple or an equivalent

check.what: Third-party login code found, no Sign in with Apple code found (heuristic)

rules.fix: Guideline 4.8: an app that uses a third-party or social login for the user's primary account must also offer an equivalent login that limits data collection to name and email, lets users keep their email private, and doesn't collect interactions for advertising without consent (Sign in with Apple qualifies). Not required if the app only uses your own account system, is an education/enterprise sign-in, uses a government ID system, or is a client for a specific third-party service.

rules.title: Account creation without an apparent account-deletion path

check.what: Sign-up code found, no account deletion code found (heuristic)

rules.fix: Guideline 5.1.1(v): if your app supports account creation, you must also offer account deletion within the app.
